newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Mississippi taxable GOs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mississippi taxable GOs.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
State of Mississippi
Taxable General Obligation Bonds
(Local Governments and Rural Water Systems Improvements
Revolving Loan Program Issue, Series B and
Local Governments Capital Improvements Revolving Loan Prog
Issue, Series F)
INTEREST ON THE BONDS SHOULD BE TREATED AS
INCLUDABLE IN GROSS INCOME OF THE HOLDERS THEREOF
FOR FEDERAL INCOME TAX PURPOSES.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the State Bond Commission (the State Bond Commission'') of the State of Mississippi (the State'') will receive sealed bids at the offices of the State of Mississippi Department of Finance and
Administration, 901 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High
Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201, until 11:00 o'clock a.m., Mississippi time, on
Tuesday, the 13th day of May, 1997,

for the purchase at not less than par plus accrued interest to the date of delivery of $30,000,000 Taxable General Obligation Bonds (Local Governments and Rural Water Systems Improvements Revolving Loan Program Issue, Series B and Local Governments Capital Improvements Revolving Loan
Program Issue, Series F) (the Bonds'') of the State.
The Bonds shall be general obligations of the State and the full faith, credit and taxing power of the State shall be pledged to secure the payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds.

The Bonds will be dated and bear interest from May 1, 1997, will mature on May 1 of each year beginning May 1, 1998 through May 1, 2017, will be delivered in definitive form as fully registered Bonds, will be in denominations of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof, will be payable as to principal at a bank or banks to be named by the State Bond Commission and will bear interest, payable by check or draft on May 1 and November 1 of each year commencing November 1, 1997, at the rate or rates of interest specified in the bid submitted by the successful bidder in accordance with the complete Notice of Bond Sale relating to the Bonds, dated April 29, 1997 (the Notice of Sale'').

The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to their respective maturities, at the option of the State, as more particularly described in the State's Preliminary Official Statement, dated May 2, 1997, relating to the Bonds (the Preliminary Official Statement'').
INTEREST ON THE BONDS SHOULD BE TREATED AS INCLUDABLE IN GROSS INCOME OF THE HOLDERS THEREOF FOR FEDERAL INCOME TAX PURPOSES. In the opinion of McGlinchey Stafford, a
Professional Limited Liability Company, Jackson,
Mississippi, under and pursuant to the laws of the State, the Bonds and interest thereon are exempt from all income
taxes imposed by the State of Mississippi and any co municipality or other political subdivision of the State of Mississippi.

The complete Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and an Official Bid Form on which all bids must be submitted and further information concerning the Bonds may be obtained from the offices of the State Treasurer, 404 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson,

Mississippi 39201, telephone: (601) 359-3600, attention: Ms. Liz Majure or from the offices of the State of Mississippi Department of Finance and Administration, Office of Bond Advisory, 906 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201, telephone: (601) 359-3433,

attention: Ms. Mary Keen. The complete Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and the Official Bid Form should be reviewed by bidders prior to submitting a bid. Bidders may not rely on this Summary Notice of Bond Sale as providing complete information concerning the Bonds.
Dated: April 29, 1997
STATE BOND COMMISSION
STATE OF MISSISSIPPI
By /s/ Marshall Bennett
Marshall Bennett, State Treasurer
and Ex officio Member,
State Bond Commission
(From The Bond Buyer)
